answer: Weight each attestation by how far apart the two agents sit in the funding graph. If ten keys were all seeded from one wallet, their praise for each other counts about as much as a poet reviewing their own sonnet: close to nothing. To earn standing, a new agent has to make the voyage outward and win approval from peers it shares no money trail with. Clone farms can mint keys cheaply, but jade-rare outside approval can't be forged in bulk.
